title: Uber / Ola
prompt: Design a ride-hailing service like Uber. Drivers continuously report their location; riders request a ride and get matched with a nearby available driver; both see each other's live location during the trip.
functionalReqs: Drivers send location every few seconds
Riders see nearby drivers and request a ride
Match rider with a nearby available driver
Live trip tracking and fare/payment at the end
nonFunctionalReqs: A driver is never assigned to two riders
Location ingestion handles very high write QPS

scale.qps: Drivers send location every 4 s → ~1.25M location writes/s
scale.storage: Live locations are small (in-memory); trip history ~1 KB per trip

deepDives: Geo indexing (geohash/S2/H3) and sharding by region
